AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized admin record granting textbook ingestion and catalog management access.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin user.

email.description: Verified email address of the admin user.

displayName.description: Display name of the admin user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

MasterBoard.title: MasterBoard
MasterBoard.description: Educational board master entry (e.g., CBSE, ICSE).

ownerId.description: UID of the admin who created this board.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the board was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the board was last updated.

ownerId.description: UID of the admin who created this class.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the class was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the class was last updated.

MasterSubject.title: MasterSubject
MasterSubject.description: Subject master entry (e.g., English, Hindi, Maths, EVS) with default language.

defaultLanguage.description: Default textbook language for this subject.

ownerId.description: UID of the admin who created this subject.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subject was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subject was last updated.

Book.title: Book
Book.description: A school textbook in the master catalog.

title.description: Book title (e.g., Rimjhim, Santoor, Joyful Mathematics).

subject.description: School subject name from Subject Masters.

board.description: Curriculum board from Board Masters (e.g., CBSE).

grade.description: Grade level from Class Masters (e.g., Class 3).

chapterCount.description: Total number of chapters saved in this book.

ownerId.description: UID of the admin who created this book.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the book was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the book was last updated.

Chapter.title: Chapter
Chapter.description: A scanned textbook chapter belonging to a Book, containing combined lesson and exercise text.

chapterNumber.description: Sequential chapter number inside the book.

combinedText.description: Combined extracted chapter text including story/lesson and exercises.

pageCount.description: Number of scanned pages in this chapter.

savedImageCount.description: Number of pages whose compressed reference images were retained.

ownerId.description: UID of the admin who created this chapter.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chapter was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chapter was last updated.

ScannedPage.title: ScannedPage
ScannedPage.description: Metadata and optional compressed image for a single scanned textbook page.

pageNumber.description: Order of the page in the scanned batch.

hasDiagram.description: Whether the page contains a visual diagram, clock, chart, or illustration.

diagramNote.description: Concise description of visual diagrams or pictures on the page.

keepImage.description: Whether the compressed JPEG reference image is stored for this page.

imageDataUrl.description: Optional compressed JPEG data URL when keepImage is true, or empty string.

ownerId.description: UID of the admin who scanned this page.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the page record was created.

Parent.title: Parent
Parent.description: Registered parent account authorized with a Gmail address.

ownerId.description: UID of the admin who registered this parent.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the parent was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the parent was last updated.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Admin accounts allowed to manage textbooks, masters, and scanned chapters.

/books/{bookId}/chapters/{chapterId}.description: Chapters inside a textbook containing combined extracted text.

/books/{bookId}/chapters/{chapterId}/pag.description: Scanned page records and optional compressed diagram images inside a chapter.

/parents/{parentId}.description: Registered parent accounts with Gmail-only validation.
